content:
mike: Heads up — bundling window in 02:00 UTC for the private/vpc onprem build. Need final checksums + cosign signer handoff before we kick the offline transport.

alexa: Ack. I'm re-running the shrinkwrap with the new multi-arch layer order. ETA 20m.

sarah: Can we confirm the rollback gate criteria? Last time we had a slow eviction issue during mirror pull.

raj: We should treat image-eviction as a soft fail for canary seeds (>= 95% success) and hard fail for full rollout. If a node drops >3 concurrent pulls in 10m, abort.

ops-liz: Logging that: hard-fail on >3 concurrent failures across escort lanes. Also need KMS signoff timestamp in release notes.

mike: Good. We'll do a staggered canary: 3 escort lanes, 6 seeds total, 30m observation. If canary passes, proceed with 15m rolling batches.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] pinned private-installer:v2024.03.32 -> sha256:4b7a...c9e1, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-offline/artifacts/1719999999/ , cosign: signed by key-id=projects/prod/keys/installer-signer

alexa: Confirmed artifact match locally: sha256 sums and cosign verified. Patch notes updated with pin table.

sarah: One thing — the transport bridge currently reorders chunked manifests when under latency. Suggest adding a short jitter to escort pulls to avoid synchronized backpressure.

raj: Agreed. Implement jitter=rand(0,3s) in escort runner. Non-blocking for canary.

mike: Ops-liz, please prepare emergency rollback playbook: command to re-pin previous installer and how to trigger immediate evict-of-staging.

ops-liz: Drafting now. Workflows:
```
# quick rollback
deploy-bot rollback --target private-installer --pin v2024.02.99
# evict seeds
ssh ops@escort-ctrl 'curl -XPOST http://localhost:9001/evict?label=canary'
```
Will paste full steps in the incident runbook channel.

alexa: Running final validation: manifest order, gzip checksums, offline bundle integrity. Found one file with mismatched mtime vs recorded; re-packaging. ETA +8m.

mike: Keep us posted. If re-pack finish >15m, we move window +1h. No surprise cutovers.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary seeds started: lanes=[lane-a,lane-b,lane-c], seeds=6, start_ts=1719999999, expected_observation=30m

sarah: Canary seed report (10m): lane-a=OK, lane-b=OK, lane-c=partial (2/2 nodes slower, pulling at 85-90% throughput). Monitoring kv-cache warmup.

raj: That's the eviction tail. If throughput recovers within 12m, continue. Otherwise abort.

ops-liz: Adding monitoring alert: alert if pull latency >120s for 5m across >1 lane.

mike: Decision tree: if lanes recover -> proceed to rolling batches. If not -> abort and roll back to v2024.02.99 and re-open packaging bugs.

alexa: Repack done, new artifact sha256:9d2f...aa01. Cosign signed. I'll upload and re-pin if we get green from canary.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] canary status update: 30m observation complete. lane-a OK, lane-b OK, lane-c recovered at 18m. Canary PASSED.

mike: Proceeding to rolling batches at +10m. Ops-liz, start the release notes broadcast and TTL for artifact retention.

ops-liz: Will do. Adding KMS audit entry and shipping changelog to private-customers list. :thumbsup:

sarah: Post-mortem item: add explicit jitter default to escort runner and document eviction thresholds in delivery playbook.

mike: Thanks everyone. Marking thread closed unless someone spots a late blocker.

raj: final: double-check we pushed the cosign public key to mirrors, else verify fails for offline installs.

alexa: Confirmed. Published cosign pubkey to s3://redwood-offline/keys/cosign.pub and updated installer config to fetch fallback key from KMS.

mike: Perfect. :rocket:
